story: Meet the Indian Roller (Coracias benghalensis), a distinctive bird from the Coraciidae family. Preferring habitats such as open woodland;grassland;agricultural land;savanna, this species has adapted to thrive under specific environmental conditions. With an IUCN status of Least Concern (LC), its population trends are closely watched by scientists and enthusiasts. The Indian Roller serves as an indicator species for the health of its environment. Whether you are a seasoned ornithologist or a curious nature lover, learning about the Indian Roller enriches our understanding of nature.
